{{CharInfobox |color={{autumn color}} |corecolor={{autumn color light}} |bordercolor={{autumn color dark}} |name=Solidad |jname=サオリ |tmname=Saori |slogan=no |image=Solidad.png |size=250px |caption=Solidad |gender=Female |colors=yes |eyes=Blue |hair=Salmon |hometown=[[Pewter City]] |region=[[Kanto]] |trainer=no |trainerclass={{pkmn|Coordinator}} |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=AG180 |epname=May, We Harley Drew'd Ya! |enva=[[Sarah Natochenny]] |java=[[Rie Tanaka]] }} '''Solidad''' (Japanese: '''サオリ''' ''Saori'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] from [[Pewter City]] who first appeared in ''[[AG180|May, We Harley Drew'd Ya!]]''. ==History== ==={{aniseries|RS}}=== Solidad debuted in ''[[AG180|May, We Harley Drew'd Ya!]]'', where it was revealed that she had defeated [[Drew]] in his very first [[Pokémon Contest]], causing him to cry. Since then they have become friends. They keep in touch and occasionally run into each other. She also noticed that Drew became more competitive, and she thinks {{an|May}} is the reason for this. In ''[[AG182|Channeling the Battle Zone!]]'', Solidad battled May in the semifinal round of the [[Kanto Grand Festival]]. She was able to counter May's attacks as she had previously observed her battling style. She managed to win the battle against May, and then she won the final stage, giving her the [[Ribbon Cup]] and the title of [[Top Coordinator]]. Similarly to Drew, May also cried after being defeated by Solidad. In ''[[AG187|The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!]]'', Solidad was revealed to have traveled to [[Johto]]. ==={{aniseries|DP}}=== In ''[[DP077|Staging a Heroes' Welcome!]]'' and ''[[DP079|Strategy with a Smile!]]'', Solidad was seen in [[Ecruteak City]] along with [[Harley]] and [[Drew]], watching May perform live on TV at the [[Wallace Cup]]. ==Character== Solidad is more mature than fellow Coordinators {{an|May}} and [[Drew]] but still holds them in high esteem. She and {{an|Brock}} are old friends, and she used to see him often when he was still the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Pewter Gym]], even knowing him from before then. She also stated that she is old friends with [[Harley]] and that she finds him to be an interesting person. ==Pokémon== This is the list of Solidad's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Solidad |pkmn=Slowbro |img=Solidad Slowbro.png |type1=Water |type2=Psychic |epnum=AG180 |epname=May, We Harley Drew'd Ya! |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc={{p|Slowbro}} first appeared with Solidad, using psychic powers to lift the escaping {{AP|Aipom}} into Ash's arms. In ''[[AG181|Thinning the Hoard!]]'', Slowbro created a masterful display of levitating itself with {{m|Psychic}}, then using {{m|Water Gun}} to create a fountain effect. Later in the episode, it used {{m|Hyper Beam}} to single-handedly blast a {{p|Girafarig}} and a {{p|Zangoose}} out of the competition. In ''[[AG182|Channeling the Battle Zone!]]'', Slowbro was shown to be fighting alongside {{p|Pidgeot}} against [[May's Combusken]] and {{TP|May|Munchlax}}. It easily disarmed Munchlax's {{m|Focus Punch}} with Psychic, before putting Combusken to sleep with {{m|Yawn}}. It evaded Munchlax's {{m|Solar Beam}} and teamed up with Pidgeot to knock Munchlax out with another Hyper Beam. Slowbro's known moves are {{m|Psychic}}, {{m|Water Gun}}, {{m|Hyper Beam}}, and {{m|Yawn}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Solidad |pkmn=Lapras |img=Solidad Lapras.png |type1=Water |type2=Ice |epnum=AG180 |epname=May, We Harley Drew'd Ya! |vajp=Yumi Touma |vaen=Yumi Touma |desc={{p|Lapras}} is another Pokémon used in Solidad's [[Grand Festival]] campaign. With a powerful {{m|Sheer Cold}} it got through the first rounds for Solidad. Later, it was able to get Solidad to the semifinals while battling alongside Solidad's {{p|Butterfree}} against a {{p|Hitmonlee}} and a {{p|Hitmonchan}}. Lapras's only known move is {{m|Sheer Cold}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Solidad |pkmn=Pidgeot |img=Solidad Pidgeot.png |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |epnum=AG182 |epname=Channeling the Battle Zone! |vajp=Kōichi Sakaguchi |vaen=Kōichi Sakaguchi |desc=Solidad's {{p|Pidgeot}} was used during the Double Battle phase against {{an|May}} alongside Solidad's Slowbro against May's {{TP|May|Combusken}} and {{TP|May|Munchlax}}. Although it was hit hard by Combusken's {{m|Fire Spin}}, it recovered and used {{m|Feather Dance}} to dissipate the flames and send burning feathers down on May's Pokémon. It then used {{m|Double Team}} to avoid Munchlax's last desperate attack, and teamed up with Slowbro to knock it out with an Aerial Ace. Pidgeot's known moves are {{m|Feather Dance}}, {{m|Aerial Ace}}, and {{m|Double Team}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Solidad |pkmn=Butterfree |img=Solidad Butterfree.png |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |epnum=AG182 |epname=Channeling the Battle Zone! |desc={{p|Butterfree}} is one of the Pokémon Solidad used in her Grand Festival campaign. Not much is known about it, other than it being able to get Solidad to the semifinals while battling alongside Solidad's Lapras against a {{p|Hitmonlee}} and a {{p|Hitmonchan}}. Winner (''[[AG182|Channeling the Battle Zone!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{autumn color}}|bordercolor={{autumn color dark}} |ja=田中理恵 ''[[Rie Tanaka]]'' |en=[[Sarah Natochenny]] |fi=Jenni Sivonen |fr_eu=Julie Basecqz |it=Loretta Di Pisa |pt_br=Gilmara Sanches |es_la=Cristina Hernández |es_eu=Diana Torres}} ==Trivia== * The official website for Cartoon Network initially called Solidad "Samantha" in their summary for the episode of her debut. * All of Solidad's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} are from [[Generation I]], and each of them are weak to {{type|Electric}} moves. * Three of Solidad's Pokémon are the same species as Pokémon which {{Ash}} has released: {{AP|Pidgeot}}, {{AP|Lapras}}, and {{AP|Butterfree}}. ** Coincidentally, all three of those species received a type of temporary form in future generations: Lapras and Butterfree received a [[Gigantamax]] form in Generation VIII and Pidgeot received a [[Mega Evolution]] in Generation VI. *** Additionally, while not a temporary form, {{p|Slowbro}} received a [[Galarian form]] in [[Generation VIII]], in addition to its Mega Evolution in Generation VI. ** All of Solidad's Pokémon share an evolutionary relative with the Pokémon [[Ash Ketchum (EToP)|Ash owns in the Electric Tale of Pikachu adaptation]] where he still owns a Butterfree and Lapras, but has a {{p|Pidgeotto}} and a [[Giant Pokémon|giant Slowpoke]] instead of a Pidgeot and Slowbro which Solidad owns. * Solidad is the only [[rival]] from ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' who did not appear in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''. ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="float:left; background: #{{autumn color}}; border: 3px solid #{{autumn color dark}}" |- style="text-align:center" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | Language !
